title: How Language Models Compress and Compare: Understanding Selection with Token Covariance Maps
abstract: arXiv:2611.26874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many language-model tasks reduce to selecting among structured alternatives, yet we still lack a simple picture of how a decoder-only transformer organizes an entire selection prompt across depth. We introduce token covariance maps, a prompt-level geometric view that tracks how token positions co-vary in hidden-state space at each layer. This turns a structured prompt into a depth-indexed sequence of maps whose spectral and block structure can be aligned with instructions, context, and candidate answers. Across 14 decoder-only models from 4 families and 12 structured-selection benchmarks, token covariance maps reveal a robust compress-then-compare organization. Early layers represent prompts diffusely, middle layers compress them into a shared low-rank bottleneck, and late layers re-expand into context-option and option-option geometry. This organization recurs across larger fixed-template samples, deterministic prompt rewrites, pairwise

translated_title: 语言模型如何压缩与比较：通过词元协方差图理解选择任务
translated_abstract: 许多语言模型任务都可归结为在结构化备选项之间进行选择，然而我们仍然缺乏一个简单的图景来理解仅解码器Transformer如何在深度维度上组织整个选择提示。我们引入了词元协方差图，这是一种提示层面的几何视角，用于追踪各层中词元位置在隐藏状态空间中如何共同变化。这将结构化提示转化为按深度索引的图谱序列，其谱结构和块结构可以与指令、上下文和候选答案对齐。在来自4个系列的14个仅解码器模型和12个结构化选择基准上，词元协方差图揭示了一种稳健的“先压缩后比较”组织方式：早期层以弥散的方式表示提示，中间层将其压缩为共享的低秩瓶颈，后期层则重新扩展为上下文-选项和选项-选项的几何结构。这种组织方式在更大的固定模板样本、确定性的提示重写、成对……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出词元协方差图这一提示级几何分析工具，揭示了仅解码器Transformer在结构化选择任务中普遍遵循“先压缩后比较”的层级机制——早期层弥散表示提示、中间层压缩为共享低秩瓶颈、后期层重构上下文与选项间的比较几何。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces token covariance maps, a prompt-level geometric tool that reveals a robust "compress-then-compare" organization across decoder-only transformers: early layers represent prompts diffusely, middle layers compress them into a shared low-rank bottleneck, and late layers re-expand into context-option and option-option comparison geometry.
